label: workflow-intelligence-sync-hardening-closeout
topWin: PromoGrind now has the beginnings of a real workflow operating layer: inbox, provenance, calibration, Studio export, and safer queued sync behavior instead of isolated calculator results.
topGap: Sync is safer but still not truly durable per entity, and workflow history/scoring remain foundational rather than fully mature systems.
ignisNote: The distinctive pattern this session is that PromoGrind moved from workflow concepts and audit language into a more operational product loop with provenance, calibration, export, and safer sync behavior.
